messages:
Marco: quick heads-up — saw a spike in leads stuck in intake for >30m this morning, hitting our SLA. Noticed HubSpot workflow retries failing for a subset with missing enrichments. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Anya: saw it too, timeline looks like enrichment webhook timed out and the lead never entered the claim queue. A bunch were from webinar signups (emea).
Ryan: looking at the logs now. HubSpot -> enrichment service got 504s between 08:10–08:22 UTC, then the workflow didn't move the lead to the fallback list.
Carla: that explains the missed handoffs. Our heartbeat probe for the enrichment lambda showed intermittent latency around the same window. I can open a quick runbook if we want to patch the workflow to be more defensive.
Marco: yes please. short-term: can we route leads to the default SDR pool if enrichment doesn't return within 20s? Long-term: we should make the intake orchestration more tolerant.
Ryan: quick patch idea — modify the HubSpot workflow conditional to add a timeout gate and write to property "intake_status=fallback" after 20s. Example rule snippet: ```if properties.enrichment_completed == true then proceed else if now - properties.enrichment_requested > 20s then set intake_status=fallback```
Anya: prefer using HubSpot's webhook step with a retry policy + a fallback branch. That way we still surface the lead for a re-enrich attempt but don't block claim.
Carla: I'll add a monitoring alert on "leads_in_fallback_rate" and make a dashboard tile for the 20s timeout bucket. Want a pulse alert to #marketing+ops at 5% fallback/1h.
Marco: good. also let's ensure Salesforce mapping doesn't swallow the fallback owner. I saw one record that ended up ownerless because SF upsert failed on missing enrichment fields.
Ryan: note — when setting intake_status=fallback, also set fallback_owner="sdr_default_pool" and add a source_tag so SF mapping uses the fallback path. Patch for SF mapping: set owner if enrichment_owner is null.
OpsBot: deploy started: hubspot-workflows/timeout-fallback v1.2 -> staging (deploy id 0x8f3). ETA ~3m.
Anya: will test with a synthetic sign-up using an intentionally delayed enrichment to confirm the fallback path and SF owner mapping.
Carla: created ticket MKT-4587 with runbook links and alert thresholds. I'm adding a checklist: reproduce, patch HS workflow, set SF owner fallback, monitor 1h, revert if regressions.
Marco: thanks team — after monitoring 1h, if stable, we'll schedule a short change window to prod the patch. Ping here once staging green. :thumbsup:
Ryan: staging green. fallback branch executed on test lead, SF owner set to sdr_default_pool.
Anya: verified SLA: test lead routed in 12s after timeout branch, notification sent to oncall. Looks good.
Carla: alert fired correctly on the test, dashboard shows the test event. I'll keep an eye on the 1h window and post a summary.
Marco: perfect. follow-up: prioritize making enrichment idempotent and add a queuing buffer so transient 504s don't cascade. I'll add to roadmap.
